name: State of Decay: Year-One Survival Edition

commands.name: Unlimited health
commands.description: Prevents damage to the controlled survivor.

commands.name: Unlimited stamina
commands.description: Prevents normal stamina expenditure.

commands.name: Fast looting
commands.description: Reduces the time needed to search containers.

commands.name: Instant radio cooldown
commands.description: Removes radio cooldowns and usage limits.

commands.name: Unlimited consumables
commands.description: Preserves consumables when used.

commands.name: Unlimited durability
commands.description: Prevents weapons from losing durability.

commands.name: Always morning
commands.description: Keeps the game clock at 8 AM while enabled.

commands.name: Unlimited suppressor
commands.description: Preserves the equipped suppressor when firing.

commands.name: Unlimited weight
commands.description: Keeps the controlled survivor's carried weight at zero.

commands.name: No reload
commands.description: Keeps the loaded rounds when firing.

commands.name: Unlimited ammo
commands.description: Keeps reserve ammunition when reloading.

commands.name: Movement speed
commands.description: Adjusts the controlled survivor’s movement speed.

commands.name: Unlimited resources
commands.description: Replenishes the community stockpiles toward 99 units each while active.

commands.name: One-hit kills
commands.description: Makes the controlled survivor’s firearm hits lethal to common zombies. Works only with firearms.

commands.name: No recoil
commands.description: Removes firearm recoil for the controlled survivor.

commands.name: Stealth mode
commands.description: Makes the controlled survivor invisible to zombie detection.

commands.name: Resilient NPCs
commands.description: Protects the active follower from health loss and knockdowns.

commands.name: God mode
commands.description: Protects the controlled survivor from health loss and knockdowns.

commands.name: Automatic vehicle repair
commands.description: Repairs a damaged vehicle while you occupy it.

commands.name: Instant facility construction
commands.description: Speeds up manual facility orders, including construction, research, and upgrades.

commands.name: Experience multiplier
commands.description: Multiplies the expertise points earned by the controlled survivor.

commands.name: Survivor illness immunity
commands.description: Cures and prevents illness, fatigue, injuries, wounds, hunger, and low energy for survivors in your community.

commands.name: Jump height multiplier
commands.description: Multiplies the jump height of the controlled survivor.
